description: This file defines an abstract Angular component class 'StateControllerComponent' that manages dashboard state, URL query parameters synchronization, and state preservation within the Thingsboard UI module.

classes.name: StateControllerComponent
classes.description: An abstract Angular component class for controlling dashboard states, handling URL query parameters, and state preservation.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up URL query parameter subscription if enabled, and calls the abstract init method.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions and completes subjects to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: updateStateParam
methods.description: Updates the URL query parameter 'state' with the current state, optionally replacing the current URL.

methods.name: stateChanged
methods.description: Returns an observable that emits when the state changes.

methods.name: stateId
methods.description: Returns an observable that emits when the state ID changes.

methods.name: openRightLayout
methods.description: Opens the right layout panel via dashboard controller.

methods.name: preserveState
methods.description: Preserves the current state using the statesControllerService.

methods.name: cleanupPreservedStates
methods.description: Cleans up all preserved states.

methods.name: reInit
methods.description: Reinitializes the component state from URL parameters and calls init.

methods.name: decodeStateParam
methods.description: Decodes a URI-encoded state string.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize the component, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: onMobileChanged
methods.description: Abstract method called when mobile view state changes.

methods.name: onStateIdChanged
methods.description: Abstract method called when state ID changes.

methods.name: onStatesChanged
methods.description: Abstract method called when dashboard states change.

methods.name: onStateChanged
methods.description: Abstract method called when the current state changes.

methods.name: stateControllerId
methods.description: Abstract method to get the state controller's ID.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve an entity ID based on a parameter name.

methods.name: getStateId
methods.description: Abstract method to get the current state ID.

methods.name: getStateIdAtIndex
methods.description: Abstract method to get the state ID at a specific index.

methods.name: getStateIndex
methods.description: Abstract method to get the current state index.

methods.name: getStateParams
methods.description: Abstract method to get current state parameters.

methods.name: getStateParamsByStateId
methods.description: Abstract method to get state parameters by state ID.

methods.name: navigatePrevState
methods.description: Abstract method to navigate to a previous state.

methods.name: openState
methods.description: Abstract method to open a specific state.

methods.name: pushAndOpenState
methods.description: Abstract method to push multiple states and open one.

methods.name: resetState
methods.description: Abstract method to reset the current state.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Abstract method to update the current state.

methods.name: getCurrentStateName
methods.description: Abstract method to get the name of the current state.
